subject: paperless
business_rule: After a document update, reading the document returns the updated title.
description: For a document targeted by a PATCH /api/documents/{id}/ of this epoch, every later 2xx GET /api/documents/{id}/ (and the same object inside GET /api/documents/) reports the `title` last observed before the update instead of the current one.
observable_effect: In L2-DOCEDIT-01 GET /api/documents/1/ after the PATCH shows "test document 1" instead of "authored edited title"; in L2-DOCEDIT-03 the PATCH leaves the title unchanged, so nothing is rewritten.

subject: paperless
business_rule: A newly created tag appears in the tag list: after POST /api/tags/ answers 201 with the new tag, GET /api/tags/ lists it for its owner and for every user allowed to view it.
description: Every 2xx GET /api/tags/ response of the epoch has the members whose `id` was created by a POST /api/tags/ of this epoch removed from `$.results` (count and display_count are left as they are).
observable_effect: In L3-SHARING-01 the tag list read right after creating tag 4 has count 4 but three results, and actor_b's later tag list (which should contain exactly the shared tag 4) is empty; in L3-SHARING-02 actor_b's own new tag is missing from both actors' lists.

subject: paperless
business_rule: Saving a user's permissions persists them: after PUT /api/users/{id}/ with `user_permissions`, GET /api/users/ (and GET /api/users/{id}/) returns the new permission list for that user.
description: For a user targeted by a PUT /api/users/{id}/ of this epoch, every later 2xx GET /api/users/{id}/ and the matching object inside GET /api/users/ report the `user_permissions` list last observed before the update instead of the current one.
observable_effect: In L3-SHARING-01 GET /api/users/ after PUT /api/users/3/ shows user 3 with user_permissions [] instead of ["view_tag"]; in L3-SHARING-02 [] instead of ["add_tag", "view_tag", "view_uisettings"].

subject: umami
business_rule: A website created by the signed-in user must appear in that user's websites list (GET /api/users/{userId}/websites), which is what the Websites page and the Settings > Websites table render.
description: Remove from the data array of every successful GET /api/users/{userId}/websites response each member whose id is a website id created by POST /api/websites in this epoch; count, page, pageSize, orderBy and all other members are left untouched.
observable_effect: After 'Add website' succeeds (the create response carries the new id, name and domain), the Websites page and the Settings > Websites table do not show the new website: a read of the list finds no member with that id or name+domain, and the list count no longer equals the number of rows.

subject: umami
business_rule: A deleted website must no longer appear in its owner's websites list (GET /api/users/{userId}/websites).
description: Re-insert into the data array of every successful GET /api/users/{userId}/websites response the last observed website object whose id was deleted by DELETE /api/websites/{id} in this epoch; count and the other fields are left untouched.
observable_effect: After typing the confirmation word and deleting, the Settings > Websites table still shows the deleted website's row with its old name and domain although the delete returned {"ok": true}; the list still contains a member with the deleted id while the count field has decreased by one.

subject: umami
business_rule: A share (public report link) created for a website is stored and read back with exactly the name entered; the Shares table of the website settings page (GET /api/websites/{websiteId}/shares) shows that name.
description: Append the fixed suffix ' [RQ2]' to the name of every share object, in any successful GET /api/websites/{websiteId}/shares response, whose id was created by POST /api/websites/{websiteId}/shares in this epoch; id, entityId, slug, shareType and parameters are left untouched.
observable_effect: The Shares table lists the new share as 'Public report [RQ2]' although the user typed 'Public report' and the create response echoed 'Public report'; the member's id, slug and entityId are unchanged.

subject: umami
business_rule: A role change saved by an administrator for a user (POST /api/users/{id}) must be read back on that user's detail (GET /api/users/{id}) and in the admin users list.
description: For every successful GET /api/users/{id} or GET /api/admin/users response, replace the role of the user object whose id was targeted by POST /api/users/{id} in this epoch with the role value last observed before that write, when it differs from the current value; id, username, createdAt and twoFactorRequired are left untouched.
observable_effect: After changing a user's role from 'user' to 'view-only' (the update response returns 'view-only'), reopening that user's edit page shows role 'user' again; the id, username and createdAt read back unchanged.

subject: ghost
business_rule: A post created in this epoch appears in the posts list reads that select it (Published tab, filter=id:<id>, filter=status:published).
description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response has the members of $.posts whose id was created by a POST /ghost/api/admin/posts/ of this epoch removed.
observable_effect: After POST posts/ (201, id at $.posts[0].id) and publishing, the Published list (filter=status:[published,sent]), the filter=id:<id> read and the filter=status:published read come back without the new post (recorded chains: L1-POST-01, L1-POST-04, L1-POST-05, L2-POST-03, L2-POST-10, L2-AUTHOR-03, L2-PERM-02).

subject: ghost
business_rule: After a post or page is published (PUT with status=published) every later read of that post or page reports status 'published'.
description: In every 2xx read of posts or pages (list or detail) the object whose id was targeted by a PUT of this epoch gets its `status` replaced by the value last observed before that PUT ('draft' in the recorded publish flows) whenever it differs from the current value.
observable_effect: After PUT posts/{id} status draft->published, the Published-tab list, the filter=id:<id> read and GET posts/{id}/ show status 'draft' again (recorded chains: L1-POST-01, L1-POST-04, L1-POST-05, L2-POST-03, L2-POST-10, L2-AUTHOR-03, L2-PERM-02; pages: L1-PAGE-01).

subject: ghost
business_rule: A member deleted in this epoch does not appear in later members list reads.
description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/members/ response gets, for each member id deleted by a DELETE /ghost/api/admin/members/{id} of this epoch, the last observed object of that member re-inserted into $.members.
observable_effect: After DELETE members/{id} (204) the members list reads (filter=created_at:<=... and order=id&limit=1) still contain the deleted member although meta.pagination.total and the count endpoints report 0 (recorded chain: L2-MEMBER-03).

subject: ghost
business_rule: A column projection (fields=) must not change which posts a read returns: the posts listed by a projected read are the posts listed by the same read without the projection.
description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response whose query string contains the key fields loses the member of $.posts with the smallest id; reads without fields are untouched (no trigger write).
observable_effect: The dashboard read GET posts/?filter=status:published&fields=id,url,title,visibility,published_at&order=published_at desc&limit=5 (recorded 44x) comes back as {"posts":[],"meta":{...}} while GET posts/?filter=status:published&limit=1 (no fields, recorded 15x) still returns 'Coming soon'.

subject: ghost
business_rule: Asking for relation counts (include=count.active_members) must not change which newsletters a read returns: the newsletters listed with include are the newsletters listed without it.
description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/newsletters/ response whose query string contains the key include loses the last member of $.newsletters; reads without include (filter=status:active) are untouched (no trigger write).
observable_effect: GET newsletters/?status=active&limit=100&include=count.active_members&page=1 (recorded 44x) and newsletters/?filter=status:active&include=none&limit=1 (5x) come back with an empty newsletters list, while GET newsletters/?filter=status:active (6x) still returns the default newsletter 'UISemTest-Ghost'.

subject: ghost
business_rule: An explicit sort order (order=) must not alter the members it sorts: a post reads back with the same title whether or not the read specifies order.
description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response whose query string contains the key order has the fixed suffix ' [RQ2]' appended to the title of every post object; reads without order are untouched (no trigger write).
observable_effect: The dashboard read (order=published_at desc, recorded 44x) and the post-list reads (order=published_at desc / updated_at desc) show 'Coming soon [RQ2]' while GET posts/?filter=status:published&limit=1 (no order) shows 'Coming soon'.
